findings: Solved 2026-10-30 on the owner's request (exercises book by book, in Practice): Chapter 23 (Carbonyl Compounds and Carboxylic Acids) exercise as printed on PDF 115-117 (printed pages 112-114), in the book's words and order.

The book prints no answer key. MCQ keys worked out: I b, II c, III b, IV c, V a, VI b, VII b, VIII b, IX c, X c.

Numbering misprints recorded only here (kept as printed): Q2(i) sub-parts reuse i)-v) under part i); Q7 parts are numbered 'i) HCN' and 'b) NaBH4'. Q3(a) prints 'CH3.CH2-CHO' (kept).

Doubtful: MCQ X keyed (c) addition-elimination; (d) substitution describes the overall change and a reviewer may accept it. Q3(c) asks 'which one' forms C4H8O2, but both primary isomers (butan-1-ol and 2-methylpropan-1-ol) give a C4H8O2 acid; butan-1-ol is given, the other noted.

Beyond the chapter (labelled): MCQ X the addition-elimination steps.
